name: Handful of Oats (Classic)
summary: In Westfall, Old Blanchy needs oats after the Furlbrows' wagon breaks down.

sections.title: Fodder Among the Ruins
sections.body: Westfall once fed the Kingdom of Stormwind, but its farms now lie overgrown or under the control of Defias bandits and rogue harvest golems. Sacks of grain and oats remain near barns, outbuildings, and overgrown fields. Travelers and refugees stranded by broken wagons along the dusty roads can gather the leftover oats to feed their weary draft horses.

faq.q: What are Handfuls of Oats used for?
faq.answer: The oats feed Old Blanchy, a weary mare belonging to the Furlbrow family. Their wagon broke down on a Westfall road, leaving her exhausted and in need of food.

faq.q: Where can these oats be found?
faq.answer: You can gather oats from sacks scattered around abandoned farms across Westfall, especially in the southwest.

faq.q: Why are the oat sacks left unguarded?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood rose suddenly, and rogue harvest machinery rampaged through the fields. Farmers fled in haste, leaving harvested grain and other supplies in their fields and barns.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler in Westfall, gathering oats for stranded refugees like the Furlbrows offers a small act of mercy on Stormwind's neglected frontier.
